findings.title: Four mandatory Batch B L2 tests red at the acceptance baseline since Batch C
findings.detail: tests/unit/runtime/tools/test_tools_side_effect_safety.py: test_side_effect_timeout_marks_uncertain_and_blocks_replay, test_mapped_validation_error_after_executor_marks_uncertain, test_close_shuts_down_execution_pool, test_replay_before_close_preserves_exactly_once fail with RuntimeErrorCode.ABANDONED ('abandoned') where tests expect TIMEOUT / VALIDATION_ERROR / 'cannot schedule new futures after shutdown'. Bisect: green at 60a3ad53b (Batch B), red from a5f813a2c (Batch C) through 1548640708. ABANDONED for uncertain side-effect outcomes matches roadmap 3.0.5 Abandonment, so tests are likely stale, but Batch B '63 passed' is not reproducible, closure does not disclose it, and a never-started post-close() call is classified ABANDONED (may_have_started set at effect admission, invoker.py ~L1867-1871). Batch C/D/E L2 inventories omit this module.

findings.title: F3 streamable-HTTP parent-cancel physical test fails in module order
findings.detail: test_mcp_catalog_f3_streamable_http_physical_l3.py::test_f3_streamable_http_parent_cancel_during_catalog_child: assertion catalog_payload.get('error') in {'execution_admission_denied','execution_cancelled'} got None. Fails in 17-module run and in whole-module rerun (2/2); passes isolated 3/3. Order/shared-state dependence on a real-server test covering TL3/TL11. fastmcp 3.3.1 equals uv.lock pin.

findings.title: No independent review artifact for the acceptance baseline
findings.detail: Acceptance cites an external ChatGPT review at 1548640708 only inside the Cursor-authored reconciliation (4 lines); no transcript, findings, reviewer identity or timestamp. Operator approval is a text line. Nothing reconstructed.

findings.title: Roadmap exit criteria 7/8 narrowed only in qualification records
findings.detail: Criterion 7 reduced to DEADLINE_ONLY by TOOL_LIFE_X_R4_OD_EC7_RECORD.md (no heartbeat/universal liveness); criterion 8 accepted for qualification topology, durable recovery default-off, OD-R4-G-A07-PROD-ACTIVATE open. OD-EC7 absent from roadmap and FRZ checklist. Declared in closure record, hence bounded.

findings.title: P0 SHA citation slip (documentation, not evidence defect)
findings.detail: Reconciliation evidence chain and roadmap ledger cite 76a98cb3f3e4576ab694f03a5b3e270eb7694f9e as the P0 SHA; it is the SKILL-X publication commit and the P0 START_HEAD. The P0 record is f5c9330973f7af7ea1d19fbbd2afd13942faac43 (5 minutes later). P0 is docs-only, production delta 0.

findings.title: Large production delta under a certification stage; wave approvals unverifiable
findings.detail: ~110 files in intergrax/ between P0 START_HEAD and baseline (new external_operations, MCP catalog host code). Each wave cites an 'OPERATOR APPROVED' text line; authenticity not independently verifiable. Noted, not ruled on.

findings.title: pytest process did not exit after Batch A-E combined run
findings.detail: Summary printed at ~31s but pytest/uv processes remained until killed by the auditor (~10 min); leaked non-daemon thread suspected; not isolated to a module.

findings.title: Stale in-document status wording
findings.detail: Roadmap 3.0.5 header says DIST-SCALE-X CLOSED while 3.0.6 header says IN PROGRESS; F8 doc matrix rows still 'VALIDATION REQUIRED @ audit SHA' / 'OPERATOR DECISION REQUIRED'; 67/67 is historical, not re-run at publication.

findings.title: Optional extra 'mcp' required to run 8 mandatory modules
findings.detail: Default uv run pytest cannot collect TL11/L3-R2/F3 modules (ModuleNotFoundError: fastmcp); needs uv run --extra mcp.
